title: Day 19 · A city in its own garden

posts.title: 233 settlers grow almost everything they eat a few minutes from bed — Maia City, day 19
posts.text:
Two hundred and thirty-three people.
Thirteen domes in one ring.
And almost nothing they eat travels further than a few minutes' walk.

Not long ago, the food came from far away — carried by trucks across a tired land.
Here, breakfast grows twenty paces from the bed.

One full day inside a dome cell, in 2 minutes 49 seconds: the sunrise through the glass, mango and fig, coffee and cacao climbing toward the light, the food forest with its hens and geese and bees, the commons where young and old learn from each other — and the night.

Nothing here was handed down from a distant capital.
Every dome was raised by the people who now live beneath it.

This is day 19 of building Maia City in public — first in game, then in real.
The goal: a city with 1 million co-founders.

Voice: Spuds Oxley · original score · filmed inside avenCITY Sandbox 4 · a self-sufficient city of geodesic domes, food forests and solar glass

233 people.
13 domes.
Almost nothing they eat travels further than a few minutes' walk.

Day 19 of building Maia City: one full day inside a dome cell, sunrise to night, in 2:49.

First in game, then in real.

Not long ago, the people who live here bought almost everything they ate from far away — carried by trucks across a tired land.

Today, 233 of them grow almost all of it a few minutes' walk from where they sleep.

Under the glass, mango and fig, coffee and cacao climb in layers toward the light.
The glass that shelters them is also their power.
Between the domes: a food forest, hens beneath the trees, geese by the water, bees among the blossoms.

13 domes stand in one ring — one dome cell.
At its centre, the great dome is the commons: workshops where young and old learn from each other, and a stone theatre open to every one of them.

Nothing here was handed down from a distant capital. Every dome was raised by the people who now live beneath it.

This is day 19 of building Maia City in public — first in game, then in real. The film runs 2 minutes 49 seconds: one full day, sunrise to night.

The goal is a city with 1 million co-founders.
The first dome cell has 233.

Would you live here?

Breakfast grows twenty paces from the bed.

233 settlers. 13 geodesic domes. A food forest of mango, fig, coffee and cacao — and almost nothing they eat travels further than a few minutes' walk.

One full day inside a self-sufficient dome cell, sunrise to night: day 19 of building Maia City, first in game, then in real.
